newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks finally take a breather, close lower.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks finally take a breather, close lower.

text.p: Madrid stocks took a much-need breather and closed lower on Thursday as the market succumbed to profit-taking after recent highs, dealers said.
Bond losses also weighed on the bourse, they added.
The general index fell 2.22 points, 0.44 percent, to 502.19 and the Ibex shed 29.57 points, 0.51 percent, to 5,772.69.
Other stocks consolidated - Telefonica lost 10 pesetas to 3,710, Repsol shed 80 pesetas to 6,150 and Endesa dropped 160 pesetas to 9,920.
BCH fell 40 pesetas to 4,385 after first quarter earnings, which rose 20 percent, met analyst expectations.
Popular bucked the trend after yesterday's announced buyback, adding 1,290 pesetas, 4.44 percent, to 30,340 pesetas.
The bank was seen continuing higher after a warm reception for results plus a recommendation from Goldman Sachs.
But otherwise stocks could have more to slide.
"The correction seems absolutely logical to me, I think the market should even have ended lower, although you can't bet against the trend," said a fund manager.
"The reasonable thing is to see the market tired, although the base is firm," he added.
